items.raw_excerpt: Nearly a month after vast swathes of Queensland were drought declared, pastures are bare, rivers have stopped running, and hay sheds sit empty.
items.summary_en: Nearly a month after vast areas of Queensland were declared in drought, pastures have dried up, rivers have stopped running, and hay sheds sit empty. Farmers are struggling to find feed for their livestock as conditions worsen.

items.title_en: Queensland graziers pushed to the brink as feed runs dry

items.raw_excerpt: Officials in Puerto Vallarta are educating the public about increased human-crocodile encounters as tourism development expands.
items.summary_en: Officials in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico are educating residents and visitors about rising human-crocodile encounters. As tourism development expands into coastal habitats, crocodiles are more frequently crossing into populated areas. The city has launched awareness campaigns on what to do if you see a crocodile.

items.raw_excerpt: Health New Zealand believes the technology behind its failure-prone cervical screening register is largely OK - but not entirely.
